company.description:
byAlinePate is a sustainability-focused tech start-up that has invented a new lifestyle ecosystem. Starting with the HydroArtPod, a smart automated home indoor garden device, there is also a companion App that uses intelligent software to support the journey to a better and healthier lifestyle. Add-on features included automated recipe generation, CO2 savings per harvest and automated monitoring of user’s nutritional intake. To create a truly exceptional user experience, convenient pre-dosed consumables ensure consistent results all year round with minimum effort and no knowledge required. 
The system is perfect for those on weight management programs, for nutrition-focused athletes, families and foodies.
The HydroArtPod is a fully integrated system that uses the power of technology to deliver a first-class growing experience to its users, fitting into their lifestyle and enhancing their home decor.

insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $2,230,000 to $2,061,158, a 0.92x increase.
